reviews.text:
My daughter got her ears pierced by Aaron. I just want to say thank you to him- it wasn’t an easy session- my daughter got scared after her first lobe and didn’t want to finish the second one. Aaron was very patient and with his quick thinking we were able
To get the second lobe done. He even told my daughter it was ok if she yelled- which she did. lol thank you Aaron for your patience and kind demeanor.
reviews.author: Audrey Garcia

reviews.text: I called Aaron out of the blue and the message said to text him for a faster response. I texted and he responded instantly. We set up an appointment, he was prompt, and gave me an intro that explained the entire appointment.  We got started and I was out the door about 15 minutes later and I love my new piercings.  As soon as they heal, I will go back to him for more.
reviews.author: cori criss

reviews.text: Aaron is very professional and excellent at piercing. I'm always very pleased with his work. He responds quickly to requests and makes everything easy!
reviews.author: Karen Riddell

reviews.text: Got my nose pierced by Aaron today and it was the best experience. I had never had a professional piercing before and I was incredibly nervous. Aaron was so calming and talked me through the whole process. You can really tell this is his passion and he loves what he does. 10/10 recommend!
reviews.author: Taylor Kimmes

reviews.text: Aaron was awesome, patient and fun with my 6 year old getting her ears pierced for the first time. Super professional and friendly. It was such a great experience I went back the next day to get my nose pierced. Now both both my daughter and I have matching purple opals. Aaron was super informative and helpful. He had great, high quality jewelry to choose from and setup was very clean.
reviews.author: Beth
